name: Planar Observatory Tower
description: The Planar Observatory Tower rises above the Arcane Sanctum, providing a vantage point for monitoring planar anomalies, celestial alignments, and arcane disturbances. Observation rings, scrying lenses, planar attunement pylons, and arcane telescopes define this elevated sanctum. Planar observers, arcanists, and sanctum technicians maintain constant vigilance.
